mapper.select: SELECT AS target_id, user_no, content, is_deleted AS deleted, feed_id, NULL AS parent_comment_id feed_id, NULL AS parent_comment_id (SELECT c.feed_id FROM ultary_feed_comment c WHERE c.feed_comment_id = ultary_feed_reply.feed_comment_id) AS feed_id, feed_comment_id AS parent_comment_id FROM WHERE = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM ultary_ai_moderation_state WHERE target_type=#{kind} AND target_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE ultary_ai_moderation_state SET latest_version=#{latestVersion}, approved_version=#{approvedVersion}, approved_content=#{approvedContent},has_approved=#{hasApproved} WHERE target_type=#{targetType} AND target_id=#{targetId}
mapper.select: SELECT j.job_id FROM ultary_ai_moderation_job j WHERE ((j.status='PENDING' AND j.next_attempt_at <= NOW()) OR (j.status='PROCESSING' AND j.lease_until <= NOW())) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ultary_ai_moderation_job older WHERE older.target_type=j.target_type AND older.target_id=j.target_id AND older.content_version < j.content_version AND older.status IN ('PENDING','PROCESSING')) ORDER BY j.job_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE ultary_ai_moderation_job SET status='PROCESSING',attempt_count=attempt_count+1, claim_token=#{token},lease_until=DATE_ADD(NOW(),INTERVAL 120 SECOND) WHERE job_id=#{id} AND ((status='PENDING' AND next_attempt_at <= NOW()) OR (status='PROCESSING' AND lease_until <= NOW()))
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ultary_ai_moderation_job WHERE job_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE ultary_ai_moderation_job SET status=#{status},last_error_code=#{lastErrorCode},last_error=#{lastError}, result_action=#{resultAction},lease_until=NULL,claim_token=NULL, next_attempt_at=DATE_ADD(NOW(),INTERVAL #{retryDelay} SECOND), finished_at=IF(#{status}='PENDING',NULL,NOW()) WHERE job_id=#{jobId} AND claim_token=#{claimToken} AND status='PROCESSING'
UPDATE SET content=#{content},updated_at=NOW() WHERE =#{id} AND is_deleted=0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ultary_ai_moderation_job WHERE target_type=#{kind} AND target_id=#{id} AND job_id != #{jobId} AND admin_review_status='DELETED' FOR UPDATE
